newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate falls at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate falls at latest auction.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury bills fell to 13.86 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 13.89 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Tuesday.
Applications for the 82.4 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 65.4 million kwacha. The average price was 97.0 percent.

The average rate for six-month bills rose to 15.33 percent from 15.08 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 87.9 million kwacha of six-month bills on offer totalled 55.9 million. The average price was 93.38 percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate rose to 15.12 from 14.64 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 73.0 million kwacha of nine-month bills on offer were fully subscribed at 73.0 million at an average price of 93.0 percent.
